results.description: The result of the last executed search step. If the last step is an `element-hydration` step, this is a plain array of hydrated elements. Otherwise, its shape depends on the last step's type (e.g. `{ elements, totalHits, maxScore }` for `elasticsearch-query-dsl-mixin`, or `{ paths }` for `cypher-path-subset`).

debug.description: Only present if the request body's `debug` property was set to true. Contains one entry per executed search step, with step-specific timing and query information.
